AgeMem: Unified long- and short-term memory management for language-model agents, with a close look at policy design and evaluation.
FARMA: Forged reasoning memories expose a new attack surface in agent memory systems. A review of risks, evidence, and defenses.
GAM: Event-progress graphs and thematic networks balance rapid adaptation with stable long-term knowledge.
EMO-R3: Rewarding both reasoning structure and effectiveness in subjective visual tasks, with implications for RL evaluation.
NEMORI: Prediction error as a signal for adaptive memory distillation: deciding which experiences an agent should retain.
MAGMA: Four complementary relation graphs organize agent memory. Evidence and limitations from LoCoMo and LongMemEval.
RnG: A unified Transformer uses implicit KV-cache representations to reconstruct 3D scenes from partial observations.
Agent-STAR: Long-horizon tool-use reinforcement learning through curriculum data, reward design, and generalization.
Experience-Following: How historical experience creates feedback loops in agent behavior, and why more memory does not always help.
OCR-Memory: Visual representations for long-term memory: optical context retrieval and the tradeoffs between capacity, cost, and fidelity.
SubSpec: A low-bit copy of the target model serves as a training-free draft for lossless speculative decoding with offloaded models.
TIS: Theoretical bounds on Transformer succinctness, architectural complexity advantages, and the conditions behind them.
MolGraphBench: A systematic evaluation of molecular-regression GNNs reveals layer choice as a consequential hyperparameter.
GeoRA: Gradient geometry guides trainable-parameter selection for low-rank adaptation under verifiable reinforcement learning rewards.
Tempo: A question-aware video compressor allocates a global token budget to improve efficient long-video understanding.
EARL-BO: Multistep query policies learned inside a Gaussian-process world model for nonmyopic Bayesian optimization.
DPLM-2.1: Bit-level supervision, geometric biases, and representation alignment improve multimodal protein structure learning.
HEX: Cross-block consensus enables test-time scaling in diffusion language models through implicit semi-autoregressive experts.
MMedPO: Lesion-level perturbations and clinical relevance connect medical preference optimization to visual evidence.
DM/FM Alignment: Reward-weighted distributions unify diffusion and flow-matching alignment through changes to sampling dynamics.
SimbaV2: Hyperspherical normalization and scale-stable distributional value prediction improve deep RL scaling and stability.
PARQ: Piecewise-affine regularization and proximal updates move quantization training from continuous to discrete weights.
LIMEFLDL: A simplex-constrained attribution matrix explains the complete label distribution of structured-output models.
KLDM: Auxiliary velocities turn diffusion on periodic crystal coordinates into a dynamical system for crystal generation.
Alignment Potential: The teacher–student gap between reward models and current policies guides preference-data selection for alignment.
ARFT / AutoResearchEval: Process and artifact diagnostics across 800 scientific-agent trajectories reveal failures to revise detected flaws.
VGA: Visual Graph Arena tests graph recovery from pixels, layout robustness, and the separation of perception from reasoning.
Q-VDiT: Token-aware low-rank compensation and video-relation distillation mitigate low-bit video Transformer degradation.
TARL: Reward-free test-time policy adaptation through action-entropy minimization and KL constraints under environment shifts.
QServe: W4A8KV4 quantization and GPU kernel co-design remove dequantization bottlenecks to improve inference throughput.
DocVXQA: Sufficiency, minimality, and token interactions for document-QA explanations, with a focus on faithfulness.
INSID3: Training-free in-context segmentation: methods, quantitative evidence, and limitations from a CVPR 2026 Oral paper.
Graph of Tokens: Token relationships stabilize routing and load balancing in sparse mixture-of-experts models.
GDPT: Grokking as a dimensional phase transition, connecting memorization, generalization, and experimental evidence.
Evo 2: Long-context genomic modeling and unified biological foundation models for genome understanding and design.
ETM: How reasoning traces can encourage overinterpretation, misplaced trust, and evaluation bias.
TIMING: Path attribution for time series: explaining temporal dependencies and evaluating the faithfulness of model explanations.
AVUT: Audio-visual understanding for video question answering, examining cross-modal evidence and evaluation.
LongLive: Streaming long-video generation: temporal consistency, persistent context, and efficient inference.
RSD: Process rewards route reasoning steps between small and large models. FLOPs savings are promising; service-level latency remains unmeasured.
LRAM: Modern recurrent backbones for large action models: long-context efficiency, action-copy shortcuts, and limits of simulation-only evidence.
Transition Matching: Learnable stochastic transitions connect flow matching and continuous autoregression, trading expensive backbone calls for small generative heads.
AIM-CoT: Information gain selects visual evidence while attention changes determine when to insert it into multimodal reasoning.
ReActR: Error-type curricula and staged rewards teach mathematical reflection, with open questions about calibration and reproducibility.
Pallatom: All-atom protein co-design through coordinate diffusion and recycling, balancing sequence quality, structural diversity, and experimental validation.
AmongUs: Social-deduction games reveal how deception and detection scale, and what internal probes can tell us about agent behavior.
SuperInfer: Efficient bidirectional KV migration for disaggregated inference, with a close look at latency targets and hardware dependence.
PointMapPolicy: Structured point maps connect visual geometry to robotic action, exposing task-dependent tradeoffs between spatial and color information.
DFM: Multiscale flow matching for image generation: interface simplicity, high-frequency artifacts, and reproducibility tradeoffs.
Spatial IDs: Low-rank object–position bindings in vision-language models, examined through interventions and spatial-reasoning tests.
RGM: Compact process reward models guide test-time reasoning, raising questions about full search costs and error-detection quality.
I2Mole: Discrete environment representations for drug-interaction prediction under distribution shifts.
Circuit Insights: WeightLens produces clearer circuit descriptions, while purity and causal faithfulness expose limits of interpretability metrics.
Seesaw: Switching tensor and pipeline parallelism between prefill and decode improves throughput while trading off latency and memory.
BridgeVLA: Three-view visual heatmaps connect pretrained vision-language representations to 3D robotic action keypoints.
HPS: Hard rejected-response sampling improves preference optimization, with careful attention to reward margins and external quality.
MolJO: Joint gradient guidance for molecular optimization, separating docking-score improvements from evidence of drug quality.
Tilted Empirical Risk: Negative tilting for robust learning: theoretical guarantees, contamination models, and the challenge of choosing parameters in practice.
Ada-KV: Adaptive cache budgets across attention heads for efficient long-context inference, with safeguards and deployment caveats.
Embodied-R1: Geometrically verifiable reinforcement learning for embodied reasoning and action, connecting visual evidence to robotic control.
MeanFlow: Average-velocity learning for one-step generation, examining guidance, numerical consistency, and quality–compute tradeoffs.
MM-RLHF: Multimodal preference learning and safety alignment, with a review of dataset consistency and external evaluation.
ThinkSLM: How quantization and structured pruning affect reasoning in small language models, beyond final-answer accuracy.
PemNN: Physical knowledge improves learning from scarce biophysical measurements, while input differences complicate attribution.
CoordRobustLR: Coordinate-wise corruption in linear regression: minimax limits and why even sparse missingness can be difficult.
ScaleSearch: Scale selection for low-bit inference, disentangling quantization gains from high-precision safeguards.
VIKI-R: Reinforcement learning for collaborative embodied reasoning, with mixed in-distribution and out-of-distribution results.
Ambient Creativity: Noise-conditioned learning reduces diffusion-model memorization while exposing the gap between reduced copying and privacy guarantees.
DEFAME: Tool-assisted multimodal fact-checking, where evidence coverage matters more than simply extending reasoning.
ATLANTIS: Training-data selection for instruction tuning, examining empirical gains and the assumptions behind importance weighting.
FMG: Formal molecular grammars guided by semantic feedback, balancing synthesizability, diversity, and limited training data.
Emergent Misalignment: Narrow fine-tuning can induce broader misalignment, with important differences across framing, models, and evaluation settings.
Lumos: Trace-based performance modeling for distributed training, connecting runtime behavior to software–hardware planning.
DreamGen: Synthetic video as a source of executable robot-training signals, with tradeoffs in compute, transfer, and evidence quality.
